blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR) quantification of amyloid PET commonly relies on a subject-specific T1-weighted MRI, yet a usable MRI is not always available. We therefore combined CT-to-MRI synthesis with conformal prediction for MRI-free PET quantification with reliability assessment. A slice-consistent Brownian Bridge Diffusion Model was strengthened with multi-dataset training and data-source conditioning to enrich the anatomical prior learned from MRI, and with expanded multi-slice CT context to exploit the through-plane continuity of subject-specific anatomy in CT. Synthetic MRI was used for FreeSurfer-based anatomical parcellation and PET quantification, while deep-ensemble uncertainty was calibrated with conformal prediction to estimate a plausible range for the corresponding real MRI-based SUVR. On $^{11}$C-PiB PET from OASIS-3, the proposed method achieved the highest synthesis and parcellation fidelity among the compared methods. Mean cortical SUVR from the proposed synthetic MRI agreed closely with the real MRI-based reference (MAE $0.016 \pm 0.015$, Pearson $r = 0.9987$) and yielded the same amyloid-positivity classification as the real MRI in all 87 test subjects at the prespecified cut-off. Conformal prediction achieved empirical coverage close to the prespecified levels, and at 90% target coverage, 85 of 87 subjects had prediction intervals that supported an unambiguous amyloid-positivity decision. Zero-shot evaluation on an independent external cohort showed that the proposed CT-to-MRI model could support PET quantification without retraining, although conformal calibration required target-cohort recalibration to recover the intended coverage. These findings support CT-to-MRI-based MRI-free PET quantification as a promising approach for providing accurate SUVR measurements and an explicit assessment of their reliability.

Amyloid PET is commonly quantified using the standardized uptake value
ratio (SUVR), which normalizes tracer uptake in cortical target regions
to uptake in a relatively amyloid-sparse reference region. Accurate
SUVR estimation requires the target and reference regions to be defined
according to each subject’s anatomy. Because PET has limited spatial
resolution and weak anatomical contrast, conventional quantification
pipelines typically rely on a subject-specific T1-weighted MRI for
anatomical parcellation [ 27 , 35 ] .

blocks.en: 2 Materials and Methods
blocks.zh: 2 材料和方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 2.1 概览

blocks.en:
The proposed pipeline replaces the unavailable T1-weighted MRI with a synthesized MRI from a brain CT and then applies the same PET
quantification procedure used in the conventional MRI-based pipeline
(Fig. 1 ). The framework
consists of four stages. First, a CT-to-MRI synthesis model generates a
subject-specific T1-weighted MRI from the input CT. Second, the synthetic MRI
is processed with FreeSurfer recon-all [ 11 ] to obtain subject-specific anatomical
parcellations. Third, amyloid PET uptake is quantified as standardized uptake
value ratios (SUVRs) using subject-specific anatomical regions and the
cerebellar cortex as the reference region [ 35 ] .
Fourth, uncertainty in the MRI-free SUVR estimate is quantified using a deep
ensemble [ 22 ] and calibrated with conformal
prediction [ 1 ] to construct a prediction interval
for the corresponding real MRI-based SUVR. The interval is then used to
distinguish confident from indeterminate amyloid-positivity decisions.
The downstream parcellation and PET quantification procedures are identical
to those used with the real MRI, with only the anatomical image replaced.

blocks.en:
Building on the slice-consistent BBDM framework [ 7 , 26 ] , we introduce multi-dataset training,
data-source conditioning, and expanded multi-slice CT context to better
capture anatomical variation and subject-specific information from CT.
The resulting CT-to-MRI-based PET quantification pipeline is evaluated
zero-shot on a fully independent external cohort without retraining or
adaptation of the synthesis model. We additionally examine the transferability
of conformal calibration to the external cohort and the effect of
target-cohort recalibration on external coverage.

blocks.en:
To develop a CT-to-MRI generative model that captures diverse anatomical
and acquisition characteristics and to evaluate its generalization to a
cohort independent of the datasets used for model training, we used two publicly available datasets, one in-house

model development and evaluation of the CT-to-MRI-based MRI-free PET
quantification pipeline. SynthRAD2023 [ 37 ] provided
additional paired CT–MRI data for synthesis training. The internal Severance Hospital cohort was used for
CT-to-MRI synthesis training and evaluation, providing an additional
clinically acquired CT–MRI dataset with potential applicability to
downstream PET quantification.
The Gwangju
Alzheimer’s & Related Dementias (GARD) cohort [ 5 ] was

generalization to an unseen cohort without retraining or fine-tuning.

blocks.en:
OASIS-3 is a publicly available longitudinal multimodal neuroimaging dataset
spanning normal aging and Alzheimer’s disease [ 23 ] . We used low-dose CT acquired as part of PET/CT
examinations together with T1-weighted MRI for CT-to-MRI model development
and evaluation.

blocks.en:
CT–MRI pairs were constructed by matching each CT session to the temporally
closest T1-weighted MRI from the same subject within 365 days, yielding
1,441 candidate pairs from 879 subjects. Subjects were assigned at the
subject level to a training set, a validation set for model selection, a
calibration set for conformal prediction, and a test set for final
evaluation. All available CT–MRI pairs from training subjects were retained,
whereas one pair per subject, selected by the smallest CT–MRI acquisition
interval, was used for the validation, calibration, and test sets. This
resulted in 1,052 CT–MRI pairs before quality control. After excluding
22 pairs because of data or preprocessing abnormalities, including
registration failure, corrupted volumes, or incomplete brain coverage,
1,030 usable pairs remained.

SynthRAD2023 is a publicly available multi-institutional dataset developed
for synthetic CT generation in radiotherapy and provides paired CT and MRI
data from multiple contributing centers [ 37 ] .
We used the brain subset of Task 1, which provides paired MRI–CT data for
MRI-to-CT synthesis, comprising 180 paired CT–MRI cases.
Three cases were excluded because of CT or preprocessing failures, leaving
177 usable pairs for CT-to-MRI synthesis training.

blocks.en:
The Severance Hospital cohort is an in-house clinical dataset comprising

Republic of Korea. CT and MRI examinations were paired when acquired within one year. The initial cohort included 230 CT-MRI pairs. After excluding 18

of aging and Alzheimer’s disease [ 5 ] . GARD served as a fully
independent external evaluation cohort and was not used for CT-to-MRI model

For the present study, we identified subjects with 18 F-florbetaben amyloid PET/CT and T1-weighted MRI acquired within
90 days. The CT was obtained from the same PET/CT examination as the amyloid

blocks.en: All data splits were defined at the subject level to prevent information leakage. OASIS-3 was divided into training (773 pairs from 620 subjects), validation (20 subjects), calibration (120 subjects), and test (117 subjects) sets, with multiple longitudinal pairs from the same subject retained only in the training set. blocks.en: For CT-to-MRI synthesis, the model was trained on the resulting 1,130 CT–MRI pairs, model selection used the 30 validation pairs, and synthesis performance was evaluated on the OASIS-3 and Severance test sets.

The independent GARD cohort was used only for external evaluation and was not involved in model training, model selection, or the primary conformal calibration.

blocks.en: 2.3 Image preprocessing
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 图像预处理

blocks.en:
For model development and retrospective evaluation, paired CT and
T1-weighted MRI volumes were processed in a common space before CT-to-MRI
synthesis. Both modalities were first resampled to
1-mm isotropic resolution. To reduce unnecessary spatial mismatch between
the paired CT and MRI volumes and to enable voxel-wise evaluation against the real MRI, both modalities were then rigidly aligned to
a common MNI152 space. Specifically, the CT was first rigidly registered to
the corresponding T1-weighted MRI using elastix [ 19 ] . A brain mask was then extracted from the
T1-weighted MRI using SynthStrip [ 13 ] and applied to
both the T1-weighted MRI and the registered CT. The T1-weighted MRI was
subsequently rigidly aligned to MNI152 space, and the same transformation
was applied to the paired CT. In a practical MRI-free setting where a
T1-weighted MRI is unavailable, the CT can instead be rigidly aligned
directly to MNI152 space, with a brain mask derived from the CT, before model inference.
blocks.zh:

T1加权磁共振卷在CT至MRI之前在共同空间得到处理
综合. 两种模式都首先被复制到
1-毫米同分辨度. 减少不必要的空间不匹配
为了能够对真实的核磁共振进行阴离子光学评价,两种模式均严格与
a 常见的MNI152空间。 具体来说,CT最初是严格注册的
使用 elastix [19] 进行相应的 T1 加权磁共振。 脑罩被取出
T1加权核磁共振使用合成Strip [13] 并应用于
T1加权磁共振和已登记的CT。 T1加权磁共振
紧跟MNI152空间 和相同的转换
适用于配对的CT。 在实用的无核磁共振环境中,

直接到MNI152空间,用从CT得到的脑口罩,在模型推论之前.

blocks.en:
Following Kim et al. [17] , CT intensities were clipped to the
range of [ − 100 , + 200 ] [-100,+200] HU, whereas T1-weighted MRI intensities were clipped
to the 0.01th–99.99th percentile range. Each modality was then min–max
normalized. N4 bias-field correction was not applied in this study,
following the preprocessing conventions of [ 37 ] and Kim et al. [17] .

[-100,+200] [-100,+200] HU, 而T1加权磁共振强度被剪切
至0.01-99.99百分位数范围。 每种模式都是分-最大

blocks.en: 2.4 CT-to-MRI synthesis
blocks.zh: 2.4 CT-MRI合成

blocks.en:
We developed the CT-to-MRI synthesis model based on the slice-consistent
Brownian Bridge Diffusion Model (BBDM) of Choo et al. [7] , which
builds on the Brownian Bridge diffusion framework of Li et al. [26] . BBDM formulates paired image-to-image translation as a diffusion process
between the source and target modalities. The original framework jointly generates three
consecutive T1-weighted MRI slices from the corresponding three axial CT
slices and uses MRI histogram-based style conditioning together with
ISTA-style sampling across overlapping slice groups. We retained these
components as the base synthesis framework.
blocks.zh:
我们开发了基于切片相容的 CT-MRI合成模型
Choo 等人的 Brownian Bridge diffusion Model (BBDM) (英语). [7],其中
以李等的"布朗桥扩散框架"为基础. [26] (中文(简体) ). BBDM 将成对的图像到图像翻译作为扩散过程
介于源与目标模式之间。 原始框架共同生成三个
从相应的三轴CT中连续取出T1加权磁共振切片
切片并使用以磁共振直方图为基础的样式配置
跨重叠切片组的ISTA式取样. 我们留着这些
作为基础综合框架的组件。

blocks.en:
Building on this framework, we evaluated four design strategies intended to
compensate for the limited anatomical information available in CT.
blocks.zh:
在这个框架的基础上,我们评价了四项旨在
补偿CT中提供的有限的解剖信息。

blocks.en:
Multi-dataset training (H1) jointly used paired CT–MRI data from
OASIS-3, SynthRAD2023, and the Severance Hospital cohort. Training on a
larger and more diverse set of subjects was expected to expose the model to
a broader range of brain anatomy and acquisition characteristics, thereby
strengthening the anatomical prior learned for CT-to-MRI synthesis.
blocks.zh:
多数据集培训(H1)联合使用的配对CT-MRI数据来自
OASIS-3,SynthRAD2023, 和Severance医院群。 培训a
大型和多样化的一组主题预计将使模型暴露于
更广泛的大脑解剖和获取特征,
加强以前为CT至MRI合成所学的解剖学。

blocks.en:
Data-source conditioning (H2) was introduced to account for
heterogeneity across the training datasets. Although multi-dataset training
broadens the available anatomical information, systematic differences in
scanner characteristics, acquisition protocols, and image appearance across
datasets may also interfere with learning a consistent CT-to-MRI mapping.
We therefore provided the source dataset of each training sample as an
additional conditioning variable alongside the MRI histogram condition at
each denoising step, allowing the model to account for dataset-specific
variation during training.
blocks.zh:
采用了数据源调制(H2)来核算
训练数据集的异质性。 尽管多数据集培训
拓宽现有的解剖学信息,系统差异
扫描仪特性、购置协议和图像横穿
数据集也可能干扰学习一致的CT到MRI绘图.
因此,我们提供了每个培训样本的源数据集,作为
核磁共振直方图条件旁边的附加条件变量
每个去名步骤,使模型能够计及特定数据集
培训期间的变化。

blocks.en:
Expanded multi-slice anatomical context (H3) increased the
through-plane CT context available for each prediction. Because gray–white
matter boundaries and complex cortical folding are only weakly represented
within an individual CT slice, we hypothesized that incorporating adjacent
slices would provide complementary subject-specific anatomical information
through the spatial continuity of brain structures across slices.
Accordingly, within a practical computational budget, we evaluated
progressively wider input contexts ranging from 3 to 15 consecutive axial CT
slices. We selected 15 slices for the final model based on validation
performance (Section A.6 ).
blocks.zh:
拓宽多切片解剖上下文(H3)
每一个预测都有CT背景。 因为灰色- 白色
物质边界和复杂的皮质折叠只表现得微弱
在单个CT片中,我们假设 包含相邻的
片段将提供补充的针对特定主题的解剖信息
通过大脑结构的空间连续性 跨越切片。
因此,在实际计算预算范围内,我们进行了评估。
从连续3至15个轴式CT逐渐扩大投入范围
切片块. 我们根据验证结果选取了15个片段作为最终模型
业绩(A.6节)。

blocks.en:
Segmentation-teacher feedback (H4) was explored as an auxiliary
anatomical regularization strategy. We hypothesized that explicitly
encouraging agreement in gray–white matter and other anatomical boundaries
could promote anatomically faithful synthesis beyond image-level appearance
alone. A frozen pretrained segmentation model was therefore used to provide
an additional anatomical training signal. The teacher was used only during
training and introduced no additional requirement at inference. Details of the segmentation-teacher
model, auxiliary loss formulation, and weight selection are provided in
Supplementary Section A.4 .
blocks.zh:
研究了作为辅助工具的分部-教师反馈(H4)
解剖学规范化战略。 我们的假设是明确的

In addition to the CT-to-MRI synthesis methods, we evaluated two families of non-synthesis MRI-free PET quantification baselines, with two implementations per family: PET-only template-based normalization and CT-based anatomical normalization. blocks.en:
Even if a CT-to-MRI-based MRI-free PET quantification pipeline achieves
good overall agreement with quantification based on the real MRI, this does
not ensure that the quantification error is small for every individual
subject. In a practical MRI-free setting, the real MRI is unavailable, so
the discrepancy between an MRI-free SUVR estimate and the corresponding
real MRI-based SUVR cannot be known for a given subject. We therefore aimed
to estimate, for each subject, a range of plausible SUVR values within which
the corresponding real MRI-based SUVR would be expected to fall at a
prespecified coverage level.

blocks.en: 3.1 Compensating for limited anatomical information in CT
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 对CT中有限的解剖信息的赔偿

blocks.en: We first examined which design strategies could compensate for the limited anatomical information available in CT. The cumulative ablation analysis shows progressive improvement over the BBDM baseline as multi-dataset training (H1), data-source conditioning (H2), and expanded multi-slice anatomical context (H3) are introduced (Fig. 3 ; Section A.5 ). Among these design choices, H3 provides the largest marginal performance gain, while H1 and H2 provide smaller incremental improvements. In contrast, segmentation-teacher feedback (H4) provides no significant additional improvement.
blocks.zh: 我们首先研究了哪些设计策略可以弥补CT中有限的解剖信息. 累积衰减分析显示,由于采用了多数据集培训(H1)、数据源条件(H2)和扩展多切片解剖上下文(H3),比BBDM基线逐步改善(图3;A.5节)。 在这些设计选择中,H3提供了最大的边际性能增益,而H1和H2提供了较小的递增改进. 相比之下,师资分门别类的反馈(H4)并没有带来显著的额外改善。

blocks.en: We further evaluated the extent of the multi-slice CT context by varying the number of input CT slices from 3 to 15 on the validation sets. Using a wider context than the three-slice baseline generally improves synthesis fidelity, with particularly consistent gains on OASIS-3 and performance approaching a plateau on Severance. We therefore use 15 input CT slices in the final model. Detailed results across all evaluated context sizes are provided in A.6 . Based on these analyses, the final proposed model incorporates multi-dataset training, data-source conditioning, and expanded multi-slice anatomical context.

blocks.en: Having identified the final model configuration, we next evaluated its ability to reconstruct subject-specific anatomy on the Severance and OASIS-3 test sets. The proposed model achieves the highest synthesis fidelity among the competing methods (Table 1 ). On the Severance cohort it attains 26.02 ± 2.04 26.02\pm 2.04 dB PSNR and 0.937 ± 0.018 0.937\pm 0.018 SSIM 3 ​ D \mathrm{SSIM}_{3\mathrm{D}} , and on OASIS-3 24.69 ± 0.96 24.69\pm 0.96 dB and 0.877 ± 0.018 0.877\pm 0.018 , the best on both cohorts and both metrics. Choo2024 is the second-best method, and a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test confirms that our model outperforms it with high significance ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) for both metrics on both cohorts. The remaining baselines show substantially lower performance.
blocks.zh: 在确定了最后的模型配置之后,我们接下来评估了它在Severance和OASIS-3测试集上重建特定主题解剖学的能力. 拟议模式在相互竞争的方法中实现了最高的合成忠诚度(表1)。 在Severance组中,它达到26.02±2.04 26.02\pm 2.04 dB PSNR和0.937±0.018 0.937\pm 0.018 SSIM 3 D\mathrm{SSIM}_{3\mathrm{D}};在OASIS-3 24.69±0.96 24.69\pm 0.96 dB和0.877±0.018 0.877\pm 0.018上,这两个组和两个度数都是最好的. Choo2024是第二好的方法,单面的Wilcoxon签名排名测试证实,我们的模型在两个组别上对两个度量衡都具有很高的性能(p < 0.001 p < 0.001). 其余的基线显示业绩明显较低。

blocks.en: Qualitatively (Fig. 4 ), our method and Choo2024 recover the overall cortical anatomy more faithfully than the remaining baselines, including the cerebellar folding that defines the SUVR reference region despite its weak contrast in CT. Kim2025 and LSGAN produce overly smooth cortical boundaries with substantial loss of anatomical detail. ALDM generates visually detailed MRIs, but the images contain noticeable high-frequency noise and frequently deviate from the ground truth in cortical folding patterns and other subject-specific anatomical structures. Consequently, the apparent realism of its texture does not necessarily correspond to faithful reconstruction of the individual’s anatomy. Although the synthesized MRIs produced by our method and Choo2024 appear similarly realistic, the cortical error maps reveal consistently smaller residual errors for the proposed method. The remaining errors are largely confined to boundary regions around complex cortical folds.
blocks.zh: 定性(图4),我们的方法和Choo2024比剩余基线更忠实地恢复了整体皮质解剖学,包括定义了SUVR参考区域的脑折叠,尽管它在CT中相对较弱. Kim2025和LSGAN产生过于平滑的皮质分界线,大量失去解剖细节. ALDM生成可视化的详细MRI,但图像含有明显的高频噪声,并经常从皮层折叠图案和其他主题特定解剖结构中偏离出地真. 因此,其纹理的明显现实性不一定符合个人解剖学的忠实重建。 虽然由我们的方法和Choo2024合成的MRI似乎同样现实,但皮质误差图显示,拟议方法的剩余误差始终较小。 所余出错大多局限于围绕复杂皮层折叠的边界区域.

blocks.en: A subject-level paired comparison against the strongest baseline, Choo2024, shows that the improvement is consistent across individual subjects. Our model outperforms Choo2024 for all subjects in SSIM 3 ​ D \mathrm{SSIM}_{3\mathrm{D}} in both cohorts and in PSNR on OASIS-3. For Severance PSNR, it outperforms Choo2024 in 21 of 22 subjects. All four one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests are significant ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; Fig. A.2 ).
blocks.zh: 与最强基准(Choo2024)的对等比较表明,各个主体的改进是一致的。 我们的模型在SSIM 3 D\mathrm{SSIM}_{3\mathrm{D}中在所有科目上都优于Choo2024。 对于Severance PSNR来说,在22个学科中的21个学科中它的表现超过了Choo2024. 所有四个单面的威尔考克逊签名排名测试都是显著的(p < 0.001 p <.001;Fig.A.2.).

blocks.en:
Image-level fidelity alone does not establish whether a synthesized MRI preserves the anatomical information required for PET quantification. We therefore compared FreeSurfer parcellations derived from each synthesized MRI with those obtained from the ground-truth MRI. In the voxel-wise disagreement maps (Fig. 5 ), the proposed method shows disagreement that is largely localized around cortical boundaries and sulci. In contrast, ALDM, LSGAN, and Kim2025 exhibit more extensive disagreement across the cortical ribbon and adjacent white matter. Choo2024 shows a qualitatively similar pattern to the proposed method, but with broader disagreement in several cortical regions. Quantitatively, the proposed method achieves the highest Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) and the lowest HD95 across all six evaluated anatomical regions (Table 2 ), indicating improved regional overlap and boundary agreement. Paired subject-level comparisons show
significantly better DSC and HD95 for the proposed method than for each of
the four baselines in every region, with all 48 comparisons remaining
significant after Holm correction (adjusted p < 10 − 9 p<10^{-9} ).

Choo2024显示出与所提议方法在质量上相似的模式,但在若干皮层区域存在更广泛的分歧. 从数量上讲,拟议方法在所有六个经评估的解剖区域中都实现了最高的二分类相似系数(DSC)和最低的HD95(表2),表明区域重叠和边界协议有所改善。 标的级比较显示

blocks.en: The improvement is particularly relevant in regions directly involved in PET quantification. In the cerebral cortex, which shows the lowest DSC among the evaluated regions, the proposed method achieves a DSC of 0.706 0.706 and an HD95 of 1.677 1.677 mm, compared with 0.655 0.655 and 2.317 2.317 mm for Choo2024, respectively. For cerebellar gray matter, which serves as the SUVR reference region, the proposed method achieves the highest DSC of 0.904 0.904 and the lowest HD95 of 1.873 1.873 mm. Together, these results show that the improved image-level fidelity is retained in the anatomical parcellations used for downstream PET quantification.

We next examined whether the improved anatomical fidelity of the synthesized
MRI translates into more accurate PET quantification on the OASIS-3 test set
(Table 3 ; Fig. 6 ). Accuracy was evaluated against the real MRI-based SUVR from the same subject using the identical quantification pipeline, with only the anatomical information used for PET processing replaced. This analysis therefore measures agreement with the MRI-based reference under MRI substitution rather than diagnostic accuracy against an independent biological standard.

blocks.en: Among the evaluated pipelines, agreement with the MRI-based reference was lowest for the PET-only pipelines, intermediate for the CT-based pipelines, and highest for the CT-to-MRI-based pipelines. Their estimates are compressed toward the cohort mean (slopes 0.75 and 0.69), overestimating amyloid-negative subjects, with amyloid-positivity concordances of 89.7% and 96.6%. At the prespecified MCSUVR cut-off of 1.42, the amyloid-positivity decisions
obtained from our synthetic-MRI-based MRI-free pipeline reproduced the real
MRI-based decisions for all 87 test subjects, with no false-positive or
false-negative cases. We further examined whether this agreement was
sensitive to the choice of MCSUVR cut-off and whether conformal prediction
could identify unreliable decisions when disagreements emerged. In a
supplementary sensitivity analysis, the cut-off was varied from 1.30 to 1.50
while the 90% conformal prediction intervals were held fixed. Disagreements
between the MRI-free and real MRI-based decisions occurred only at cut-offs
from 1.34 to 1.41. All such cases were designated indeterminate because their
prediction intervals spanned the cut-off. Conversely, all decisions retained
as confident remained concordant with the real MRI-based reference across the
evaluated cut-off range ( A.10 ). These results
indicate that the conformal intervals can distinguish cases requiring caution
from those for which the MRI-free amyloid-positivity decision remains stable
with respect to the real MRI-based reference.

Finally, we examined whether conformal calibration performed on OASIS-3
transferred to the independent GARD cohort. Although MRI-free SUVR
estimates retained strong zero-shot agreement with the MRI-based reference
on GARD, prediction intervals calibrated on OASIS-3 substantially
undercovered the GARD reference values. For MCSUVR, empirical coverage at
the 90% target level decreased to 62.2%. In contrast, when the same
conformal procedure was recalibrated within GARD using repeated random

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
In this study, we addressed three questions central to CT-to-MRI-based
MRI-free PET quantification. First, how can subject-specific T1-weighted MRI
anatomy be inferred more faithfully from the limited anatomical information
available in brain CT? Second, does improving this anatomical inference
translate into more accurate MRI-free PET quantification? Third, in a
practical setting where the real MRI is unavailable, how can the reliability
of an individual MRI-free SUVR estimate be assessed?

To address the first question, we strengthened the anatomical information
available to the synthesis model through multi-dataset training,
data-source conditioning, and expanded multi-slice CT context. The resulting
improvements in CT-to-MRI synthesis were accompanied by more accurate
anatomical parcellation and closer agreement with real MRI-based PET
quantification. To address the third question, we combined deep-ensemble
uncertainty with conformal prediction to estimate a plausible range for the
corresponding real MRI-based SUVR and used this range to assess the
reliability of amyloid-positivity decisions. Finally, we evaluated whether
these improvements generalized to an independent external cohort without
retraining or adaptation of the CT-to-MRI synthesis model.

therefore needed to improve the recovery of fine individual anatomy from the
limited structural information available in CT.

characteristics were most similar, but this is not a general solution. More
generalizable conditioning strategies that can infer acquisition or image
characteristics directly from the input CT, rather than relying on predefined
dataset identities, will therefore be needed for broader deployment.

Third, the present training data were not designed to systematically
represent focal or atypical brain abnormalities, such as brain tumors or
substantial white matter lesions. Medical image translation models can alter
or fail to preserve pathological features that are uncommon in the training
distribution [ 8 ] . In the present pipeline, such
errors could propagate beyond the synthesized image, because inaccurate
representation of abnormal anatomy may affect anatomical parcellation and

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In conclusion, this study improved the accuracy of CT-to-MRI-based MRI-free PET quantification and showed that, when conformal prediction is calibrated for the target cohort, the reliability of individual SUVR estimates can be assessed when the real MRI is unavailable. By strengthening the anatomical
prior learned during training and incorporating richer subject-specific
information from the input CT, the proposed approach improved CT-to-MRI
synthesis, anatomical parcellation, and downstream PET quantification relative to the other approaches evaluated here. The resulting MRI-free SUVR estimates showed close agreement with the corresponding real MRI-based reference in OASIS-3 and favorable performance
when applied zero-shot to an independent external cohort.

Beyond improving quantification accuracy, the proposed reliability framework
used deep-ensemble uncertainty and conformal prediction to estimate a
plausible range for the corresponding real MRI-based SUVR. In OASIS-3, this made it possible to distinguish cases in which an MRI-free
amyloid-positivity decision was well separated from the decision cut-off
from those in which additional evaluation may be warranted. The external evaluation further showed that
conformal calibration may not transfer directly across cohorts, but that
target-cohort recalibration can restore the intended coverage without
retraining the CT-to-MRI synthesis model. Together, these findings support the
potential of CT-to-MRI-based MRI-free PET quantification to provide both
accurate SUVR measurements and an explicit assessment of their reliability,
while highlighting the importance of robust anatomical inference and local
calibration for broader clinical deployment.

blocks.en: A.3 Non-synthesis MRI-free baseline implementation details
blocks.zh: A.3 非合成无核磁共振基线实施细节

blocks.en: We evaluated two PET-only and two CT-based implementations on the same OASIS-3 test set, using the same static PiB images as the real MRI-based reference. Processing used the SPM12 batch modules in the SPM25 standalone release. Anatomical target-region definitions matched the reference pipeline. Atlas and reference-region sources are listed in Table A.3 . The OASIS-derived and CT-based implementations used a 1-mm isotropic grid with a bounding box from ( − 90 , − 126 , − 72 ) (-90,-126,-72) to ( 90 , 90 , 108 ) (90,90,108) mm in MNI152 space. The GAAIN-derived implementation used the SPM default bounding box and a 2-mm isotropic grid.
blocks.zh: 我们在同一组OASIS-3测试中评价了两套基于PET的和两套基于CT的应用,使用相同的静态PiB图像作为真实的核磁共振参考. 处理在SPM25独立发布中使用了SPM12分批模块. 解剖目标区域的定义与参考程序相符。 地图集和参考区域来源见表A.3。 由OASIS衍生和基于CT的安装采用了1毫米同地线网格,其边框从(-90、-126、-72)(-90、-126、-72)到(90、-90、-108)(90、90、108)毫米(MNI152空间)。 GAAIN从执行中使用了SPM默认的边框和一个2毫米同地线网格.

blocks.en: The GAAIN-derived implementation recentered the image origin and rigidly coregistered PET to the template before normalization. The OASIS-derived implementation used the intensity-weighted image center for its initial translation. No separate initial alignment was applied in Presotto2018. Matsuda2021 used the skull-based alignment described below.
blocks.zh: GAAIN衍生的实施更新了图像源头,在正常化前严格地将PET与模板联合注册。 由OASIS衍生的实施使用强度加权图像中心进行初始翻译。 在Presotto2018中没有采用单独的初始对齐. 松田2021采用了下文所描述的以头骨为主的对齐.

blocks.en: These implementations adapted the template-based approaches of Edison et al. [ S6 ] and Landau et al. [ S7 ]. Both templates were averages of PiB images spatially normalized using the corresponding MRIs. Evaluation required PET only. The GAAIN-derived template used the publicly available AD-100 and YC-0 PiB calibration datasets [ S8 ]. The public release comprises 45 Alzheimer’s disease patients and 34 young controls and provides PET images with corresponding MRIs. For template construction, each PET was rigidly coregistered to its MRI before MRI-based spatial normalization. PET images were scaled by the mean uptake in the cerebellar GM reference region before averaging. The OASIS-derived template used cerebellar-cortex-scaled PET from 197 subjects (47 A+/CI, 49 A+/CU, 16 A − - /CI, and 85 A − - /CU), where A+ denotes Centiloid > 20 >20 and CI denotes CDR > 0 >0 . Its atlas used 200 separate cognitively unimpaired subjects. OASIS-3 template and atlas subjects were excluded from the validation, calibration, and test sets. Atlas construction involved warping binary FreeSurfer masks to MNI152 space, smoothing at 1.5-mm FWHM, averaging and scaling each regional map to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and assigning the highest-ranking label to each voxel. The two pipelines differ in template, atlas, and reference definition, rather than template source alone.

blocks.en: A.5 Ablation study of the proposed design choices
blocks.zh: A.5 对拟议设计选择的考虑研究

blocks.en:
We provide the detailed results of the cumulative ablation analysis summarized in Section 3.1 . Starting from the Choo2024 BBDM backbone, the proposed design choices were introduced sequentially as BBDM → + H1 → + H2 → + H3 → + H4 \text{BBDM}\rightarrow+\text{H1}\rightarrow+\text{H2}\rightarrow+\text{H3}\rightarrow+\text{H4} .
H1 denotes multi-dataset training, H2 data-source conditioning, H3 expanded multi-slice anatomical context using the 15-slice input selected in Section A.6 , and H4 segmentation-teacher feedback. All configurations were evaluated on held-out validation sets from OASIS-3 ( N = 20 N=20 ) and Severance ( N = 10 N=10 ), which are disjoint from the test cohorts used for the main synthesis evaluation. PSNR and SSIM 3 ​ D \mathrm{SSIM}_{3\mathrm{D}} were computed within the brain mask.

我们提供了第3.1节概述的累积分析的详细结果。 从Choo2024 BBDM主干线开始,按照BBDM → + H1 → + H2 → + H3 → + H4\text{BBDM → rightarrow → text{H1}\ 右Rightarrow → text{H3}\ 右Rightarrow → text{H4}顺序引入了拟议的设计选择.
H1表示多数据集训练,H2数据源调制,H3利用A.6节所选取的15个切片输入来扩展多切片解剖上下文,以及H4分解-教师反馈. 所有配置均在OASIS-3(N = 20 N = 20)和Severance(N = 10 N = 10)的悬置验证装置上得到评价,这些装置与主要综合评价所用的测试组别脱节。 PSNR 和 SSIM 3 D\mathrm{SSIM}_{3\mathrm{D}都是在脑罩内计算出来的.

blocks.en: Because every subject was evaluated using all model configurations, comparisons were performed in a paired manner. Each newly added component was compared with the immediately preceding configuration using a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test. The reported significance therefore reflects the marginal effect of adding each component to the cumulative model rather than its standalone effect. One-sided tests were used because the component ablation evaluates prespecified directional hypotheses that each added design choice improves synthesis performance.
blocks.zh: 由于每个课题都使用所有模型配置来评价,因此比较都是以对等的方式进行的. 每个新添加的组件都使用单侧的Wilcoxon签名排名测试,与前作的配置进行比较. 因此,所报告的意义反映了在累积模型中添加每个组成部分的边际效应,而不是其独立效应。 采用了单面测试,因为组件衰减评价了预先确定的方向假说,每个添加的设计选择都会提高合成性能.

blocks.en: Detailed results are reported in Table A.4 . H1 and H2 provide smaller incremental improvements within the cumulative sequence, although the H1 improvement in Severance PSNR does not reach statistical significance. blocks.en: A.10 Sensitivity of amyloid-positivity decision reliability to the MCSUVR cut-off

blocks.en:
At the prespecified MCSUVR cut-off of 1.42, the amyloid-positivity decisions
obtained from our synthetic-MRI-based MRI-free pipeline reproduced the real
MRI-based decisions for all 87 test subjects. We therefore examined whether
this agreement was sensitive to the choice of MCSUVR cut-off and whether
conformal prediction could identify unreliable decisions when disagreements
emerged. The cut-off was varied from 1.30 to 1.50 in increments of 0.01,
while the 90% conformal prediction intervals were held fixed. At each
cut-off, MRI-free point-estimate decisions were compared with the
corresponding real MRI-based reference decisions, and cases whose prediction
intervals spanned the cut-off were designated indeterminate.

blocks.en: A.11 External transfer of conformal calibration to GARD
blocks.zh: A.11 向GARD外部转让校正

blocks.en:
We further examined whether conformal calibration derived from OASIS-3
transferred to the independent GARD cohort. The same nonconformity score
used in the main analysis, defined as the absolute MRI-free quantification
error normalized by the subject-specific ensemble standard deviation, was
used throughout this analysis. For the conformal analysis, we included
82 GARD subjects with successful FreeSurfer processing and valid PET
quantification results for all ensemble members of the proposed model. For cross-cohort transfer, conformal
quantiles were estimated from the OASIS-3 calibration set and applied
directly to GARD without recalibration.

从OASIS-3校正成套数据中估算并应用了数量

blocks.en:
Direct transfer of the OASIS-3 calibration resulted in substantial
undercoverage on GARD (Table A.8 ). For MCSUVR,
target coverage levels of 80%, 90%, and 95% resulted in empirical
coverages of 42.7%, 62.2%, and 78.0%, respectively. Undercoverage was
also observed across all six regional SUVR measures at the 90% target
level, with empirical coverage ranging from 57.3% in the precuneus to
86.6% in the anterior cingulate cortex.

blocks.en:
We therefore evaluated whether coverage could be recovered using
calibration data drawn from the GARD cohort. The 82 eligible GARD subjects were randomly divided into equal calibration
and test sets ( N = 41 N=41 each), and this split-half procedure was repeated
1,000 times to reduce dependence on a particular random partition. With GARD-specific calibration, empirical
MCSUVR coverage returned close to the requested levels, reaching 81.4 ± 8.8 81.4\pm 8.8 %, 90.7 ± 6.2 90.7\pm 6.2 %, and 95.2 ± 4.6 95.2\pm 4.6 % at target
coverage levels of 80%, 90%, and 95%, respectively. At the 90%
target level, mean regional coverage across the repeated splits ranged
from 90.2% to 90.7%. Prediction intervals were correspondingly wider
than those obtained by directly transferring the OASIS-3 calibration.
These results show that GARD-specific recalibration yielded empirical
coverage close to the target marginal coverage, whereas calibration
derived from OASIS-3 did not transfer directly to the external cohort.
